jobs.description: SamenvattingStart your new job as a production operator in Oudkarspel. Work in shifts, earn extra with surcharges, and grow in the food industry!OmschrijvingAs a production operator, you are responsible for setting up, operating, and monitoring machines to ensure the production process and product quality meet high standards. You'll handle minor malfunctions yourself or quickly coordinate with your colleagues, keeping everything running smoothly. Working in a 2-shift system—one week from 05:00 to 14:00 and the next from 14:00 to 23:00—you’ll enjoy variety and clear structure. The first 10 days, you’ll receive hands-on guidance from a mentor to help you get started. You start your working day by checking machine settings, inspecting if enough supplies are present, and preparing production data. Throughout your shift, you actively monitor processes, record quality checks, and respond to any issues that arise. At the end of your shift, you make sure your workplace is clean and safe, and you complete the necessary reports so the next team can take over seamlessly. Are you ready for a challenging and rewarding job in production? Apply now and make a difference in a dynamic team where your contribution really counts!Over de opdrachtgeverYour future employer is a major food production company that makes various snacks. The company is always looking for innovative ideas and only works with pure and natural ingredients. Food is their passion, and they proudly share this with the world. They create a positive and enjoyable environment that is reflected in their products, work methods, and how employees interact. Leaving the planet a better place for future generations is at the core of their beliefs.Eisen - You have at least an mbo-level working and thinking ability - You have experience as an operator or with operating production machines, or you have experience in the food industry - You speak good Dutch or English - You are flexible and comfortable with shift

Repair & Overhaul Technician | Eindhoven Region Repair and overhaul Parts and machines with overhaul or repair work Working hours Language Dutch or English What will you be doing? This is repair and overhaul work. Parts and machines come in to you and go back out to specification, with the technical drawing as your reference. You disassemble them, assess what's worn or damaged, replace what needs replacing, and rebuild the whole as specified by the drawing. Overhaul work calls for a different kind of craftsmanship than building something new. You don't know in advance what you'll find, so your judgement determines what's needed. Anyone already doing this work in high-tech metalworking knows the difference. Repairing parts and machines according to technical drawings; Disassembling and assessing incoming parts; Carrying out overhaul work and replacing worn or damaged parts; Rebuilding and checking that everything is back to specification; Recording your findings and the work carried out. What do we offer?
